name: geizhals-mcp
description: Search Geizhals price comparison: best prices across shops, price history, deals and price alarms.
long_description: Products, best prices with the cheapest shops, price history, ratings, the full category tree, current price drops and e-mail price alarms from geizhals.at and geizhals.de. Also finds the Geizhals product behind a second-hand ad. Unofficial; uses Geizhals' mobile app API.

tools.name: get_price_history

tools.name: compare_products
